title: Queue
blurb: Work that waits for a device instead of failing. Jobs run when a node is free and fit — an iPad on the charger tonight, a Mac that wakes up in the morning.
promptPlaceholder: What should the fleet work on?
stakeHint: Credits staked buy position in the queue and are refunded if the job expires or is cancelled unrun. They never outrank this node's own work.
